description: This section focuses on the role voluntary health insurance (VHI) plays in relation to publicly financed health care, the share of population covered by VHI and its contribution to spending on health. It provides information on who sells and buys VHI, who regulates VHI and whether there are policies in place to make VHI more accessible or affordable.

name: User charges (co-payments) by type of health care
description: This section focuses on the design of user charges (co-payments) for covered services. It describes the level and type of user charges and protection mechanisms in place for the following types of health care: outpatient primary care visits, outpatient specialist visits, outpatient emergency visits, outpatient prescribed medicines, medical products, diagnostic tests, dental care visits, dental care treatment, inpatient care and inpatient medicines.

name: Changes in coverage policy
description: This section focuses on changes in coverage policy over time. It describes policy changes affecting population coverage, service coverage, user charges and voluntary health insurance.
